object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. outline's root and depth are the only parameters added since 0.3.0. That was checked on 2026-11-11 by comparing the tool list of v0.3.0 with the working tree; the comparison isn't a test. test_outline_is_preorder_with_depth is unchanged since v0.3.0, so its expected value is the previous release's answer. No write tool gained a parameter, so 'writes' has nothing to check yet.
object.description: On a document whose heading has one child, call outline with only the document ID. Then nest objects four deep and call outline with only the document ID, and with a depth deep enough to reach every object. Expected: leaving out root and depth gives what the previous release gave: each object in pre-order with its ID, depth and heading or text, and no count of descendants left out. The deep enough depth gives the same result.
